name: Madison Youth & Family Services Summer Groups (Social Skills Camp, Summer Art Group, Walk and Talk)
operator_name: Town of Madison Youth & Family Services
description_short: Short summer groups run by Madison's Youth & Family Services clinical staff. They include an afternoon social skills camp for elementary students, an expressive arts therapy group for ages 8-11, and an outdoor walk-and-talk group at Hammonasset Beach State Park for grades 6-8.

These are short clinical or therapeutic groups (1-1.5 hours a day) run by the town's Youth & Family Services clinical department. They are not a traditional full-day camp.

The page belongs to the Town of Madison government website. The address and email in the footer (8 Campus Drive, info@madisonct.org) are for the town in general, not for the program, so they were not recorded as the camp's address.
